# Abandoned Outpost

Type: Structure | Internal ID: Ruin1, StoneHouse3, StoneHouse4 | Resources: Black Forest chest, ,, Black Forest barrel | Inhabitants: Greydwarf, ,, Greydwarf shaman, ,, Greydwarf brute, ,, Skeleton, ,, Crow

# Introduction

Abandoned Outposts are Points of interest found in the Black Forest. They are ruined buildings made mainly of Stone structures and are guarded by Greydwarfs and Skeletons. They come in 9 different versions.
All versions have two Crows flying around.

## Greydwarf Ruins

Greydwarf Ruins have only the base of a stone building and come in three variants.
One variant always has a Black Forest chest and is protected by three Greydwarfs and one Greydwarf shaman.
Another variant always has a Black Forest chest and is protected by a single Greydwarfs.
The last variant has no chest and is protected by up to two Greydwarfs with a 50% chance each. It is recognizable by its stone doorway arch.

## Greydwarf Tower

Greydwarf Tower always has a full tower tower. It has a 30% chance for a Vegvisir indicating the closest altar for The Elder. It always has a Black Forest chest and a Black Forest barrel. The Stool can be destroyed for Finewood.
It is guarded by 6 Greydwarfs plus a 20% chance for a seventh and a 20% chance for a Greydwarf brute.

## Skeleton Tower

Skeleton Tower are stone ruins with multiple missing parts guarded by 2 to 7 Skeletons.
They have a chance for a Black Forest chest to spawn on the top floor (25% chance for version 7, 8, 10 and 50% for version 9).
Notably, they do not have Vegvisir.

## Contested Tower

Contested Tower has two parts, a stone foundation is always present and a tower with an 81.3% chance to spawn.
If the tower is present, a Black Forest chest is hidden inside the wall, in the far right corner of the tower from the entrance. Inside the tower, a Table and a Chair can be destroyed for 3 Finewood, there is a 28.1% chance for a Wild Beehive and a 30% chance for a Vegvisir. The tower can be guarded by a Greydwarf and a Greydwarf brute with a 50% chance each .
There is a 33% chance for 6 Skeletons to guard the ruin. If they spawn, there is a Black Forest chest hidden inside at the base of the ruin, in the right corner from the tower entrance. It can be accessed by destroying the wooded floor.
A group of 3 Greydwarfs has a 50% to spawn around the ruin. Since Greydwarfs and Skeletons are in enemy factions, they will fight each other when they both spawn.

Categorias: Points of interest
